panels.title: Who is here? (all signed-up people)

targets.rawSql:
with activity as (
  select authorid uid, created::timestamptz ts, 'rack' k from public.racks where authorid is not null
  union all select authorid, created::timestamptz, 'patch' from public.patches where authorid is not null
  union all select authorid, created::timestamptz, 'collection' from public.module_collections where authorid is not null
  union all select "authorId", created, 'comment' from public.comments where "authorId" is not null
  union all select user_id, created_at, 'reaction' from public.reactions
  union all select profileid, updated::timestamptz, 'module list' from public.user_modules
  union all select profileid, created_at, 'acquisition' from public.user_module_acquisitions),
p as (select u.id, exists(select 1 from activity a where a.uid=u.id and a.k in ('rack','patch')) b,
  exists(select 1 from activity a where a.uid=u.id and a.k in ('module list','collection','acquisition')) c,
  exists(select 1 from activity a where a.uid=u.id and a.k in ('comment','reaction')) s
  from auth.users u where u.deleted_at is null)
select seg as segment, n as people from (
 select 'Builders (made a rack or patch)' seg, count(*) n, 1 o from p where b
 union all select 'Collectors (track modules, no builds)', count(*), 2 from p where not b and c
 union all select 'Social only (comment / react)', count(*), 3 from p where not b and not c and s
 union all select 'Signed up, nothing yet', count(*), 4 from p where not b and not c and not s) t order by o

panels.description: Each person counted once, in the first matching group.

targets.rawSql:
with activity as (
  select authorid uid, created::timestamptz ts, 'rack' k from public.racks where authorid is not null
  union all select authorid, created::timestamptz, 'patch' from public.patches where authorid is not null
  union all select authorid, created::timestamptz, 'collection' from public.module_collections where authorid is not null
  union all select "authorId", created, 'comment' from public.comments where "authorId" is not null
  union all select user_id, created_at, 'reaction' from public.reactions
  union all select profileid, updated::timestamptz, 'module list' from public.user_modules
  union all select profileid, created_at, 'acquisition' from public.user_module_acquisitions)
select step, n as people from (
 select '1 Signed up' step, count(*) n from auth.users where deleted_at is null
 union all select '2 Logged in again after day one', count(*) from auth.users where last_sign_in_at > created_at + interval '1 day'
 union all select '3 Tracks modules / collections', count(distinct uid) from activity where k in ('module list','collection','acquisition')
 union all select '4 Built a rack or patch', count(distinct uid) from activity where k in ('rack','patch')
 union all select '5 Shared something publicly', count(distinct a) from (
   select authorid a from public.racks where public union all select authorid from public.patches where public
   union all select authorid from public.module_collections where public) s
 union all select '6 Commented or reacted', count(distinct uid) from activity where k in ('comment','reaction')) t order by step

panels.title: Retention by signup month

targets.rawSql:
with built as (select distinct authorid a from public.racks union select authorid from public.patches)
select to_char(date_trunc('month', u.created_at), 'YYYY-MM') as month, count(*) as signed_up,
  count(*) filter (where b.a is not null)::float / count(*) as builders,
  count(*) filter (where u.last_sign_in_at > now() - interval '30 days')::float / count(*) as active_30d
from auth.users u left join built b on b.a = u.id where u.deleted_at is null and u.created_at > now() - interval '12 months'
group by 1 order by 1 desc

panels.description: builders = share who made a rack or patch ever; active_30d = share who logged in during the last 30 days.

panels.title: Weekly active creators vs new signups

targets.rawSql:
with activity as (
  select authorid uid, created::timestamptz ts, 'rack' k from public.racks where authorid is not null
  union all select authorid, created::timestamptz, 'patch' from public.patches where authorid is not null
  union all select authorid, created::timestamptz, 'collection' from public.module_collections where authorid is not null
  union all select "authorId", created, 'comment' from public.comments where "authorId" is not null
  union all select user_id, created_at, 'reaction' from public.reactions
  union all select profileid, updated::timestamptz, 'module list' from public.user_modules
  union all select profileid, created_at, 'acquisition' from public.user_module_acquisitions)
select time, metric, n from (
 select $__timeGroup(ts, '1w') as time, 'active creators' as metric, count(distinct uid) n from activity where $__timeFilter(ts) group by 1
 union all select $__timeGroup(created_at, '1w'), 'new signups', count(*) from auth.users where $__timeFilter(created_at) group by 1) t order by time
